message.content:
I don’t have real‑time data built into this chat, but you can quickly find the current air quality index (AQI) for Los Angeles by visiting one of the following reliable sites:

| Source | How to use |
|--------|------------|
| **EPA AirNow** – https://www.airnow.gov/ | Enter “Los Angeles” or your ZIP code; it will show the latest AQI and pollutant breakdowns. |
| **AirVisual / IQAir** – https://www.iqair.com/usa/california/los-angeles | Provides a map view, hourly forecast, and historical trends. |
| **BreezoMeter** – https://www.breezometer.com/ | Offers an interactive map and mobile app for up‑to‑minute updates. |

If you’re looking for a quick snapshot, just search “LA AQI” in Google and the top result will display the current AQI along with a color‑coded health advisory.
